people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord king David live forever!”
translations.bsb: Bathsheba bowed facedown in homage to the king and said, “May my lord King David live forever!”
translations.kjv: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
translations.asv: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did obeisance to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
